### Analisis Data Eksploratif

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(e1071)

df_pre  <- read.csv("Dataset Tugas Besar ADS - Survei Kepuasan Sebelum Test.csv")
df_post <- read.csv("Dataset Tugas Besar ADS - Survei Kepuasan Setelah Test.csv")

skor_pre  <- rowSums(df_pre[, 2:11])
skor_post <- rowSums(df_post[, 2:11])
selisih   <- skor_post - skor_pre

ringkasan_statistik <- function(x, nama) {
  q1  <- quantile(x, 0.25)
  q3  <- quantile(x, 0.75)
  iqr <- IQR(x)
  batas_bawah <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  batas_atas  <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("STATISTIK DESKRIPTIF:", nama, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  cat("Jumlah Sampel (n) :", length(x), "\n")
  cat("Mean              :", round(mean(x), 4), "\n")
  cat("Median            :", round(median(x), 4), "\n")
  cat("Standar Deviasi   :", round(sd(x), 4), "\n")
  cat("Varians           :", round(var(x), 4), "\n")
  cat("Minimum           :", min(x), "\n")
  cat("Kuartil 1 (Q1)    :", q1, "\n")
  cat("Kuartil 3 (Q3)    :", q3, "\n")
  cat("Maksimum          :", max(x), "\n")
  cat("IQR               :", iqr, "\n")
  cat("Skewness          :", round(skewness(x), 4), "\n")
  cat("Batas             : [", batas_bawah, ",", batas_atas, "]\n")
}

ringkasan_statistik(skor_pre,  "SKOR SEBELUM TES")
ringkasan_statistik(skor_post, "SKOR SETELAH TES")
ringkasan_statistik(selisih,   "SELISIH SKOR (SETELAH - SEBELUM)")
```

BOXPLOT

```{r}
boxplot(skor_pre, skor_post,
        names = c("Sebelum Tes", "Setelah Tes"),
        col = c("#95A5A6", "#2ECC71"),
        ylim = c(8, 52),
        las = 1,
        main = "Perbandingan Skor Pemahaman Next.js\nSebelum dan Setelah Tes",
        ylab = "Skor Total (10 - 50)")
grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL, lty = 2, col = "lightgray")
```

HISTOGRAM

```{r}
hist(selisih,
     prob = TRUE,
     breaks = 10,
     col = "#AED6F1",
     border = "white",
     ylim = c(0, 0.06),
     las = 1,
     main = "Distribusi Selisih Skor (Setelah - Sebelum)",
     xlab = "Selisih Skor Total",
     ylab = "Densitas")
lines(density(selisih), col = "#1B4F72", lwd = 2)
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lwd = 1.5, lty = 2)
abline(v = mean(selisih), col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2, lty = 1)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Kurva Densitas", "Titik Nol (0)", "Rata-rata (+5,35)"),
       col = c("#1B4F72", "red", "darkgreen"),
       lty = c(1, 2, 1),
       lwd = 2,
       bty = "n",
       cex = 0.85)
```

Q-Q Plot

```{r}
qqnorm(selisih,
       pch = 19,
       col = "#3498DB",
       las = 1,
       main = "Normal Q-Q Plot Selisih Skor",
       xlab = "Kuantil Teoritis (Normal)",
       ylab = "Kuantil Sampel")
qqline(selisih, col = "red", lwd = 2)
grid(lty = 2, col = "lightgray")
```

### **Uji Normalitas**

```{r}
uji_normalitas <- shapiro.test(selisih)
print(uji_normalitas)
```

### Uji-t dua populasi data berpasangan

```{r}
uji_t <- t.test(skor_post, skor_pre,
                paired = TRUE,
                alternative = "two.sided",
                conf.level = 0.95)
print(uji_t)
```
